column2: As I am sure you know, as an angel, you must not intervene directly in the world below.{wait}{clear}
Always work through people, and let them set right the turmoil of their world themselves.{wait}{clear}
It would be wise to take a helper from the fairy realm with you to the surface.{wait}{clear}
＄＄＄＄＄＄, welcome.{wait}{clear}
I have called you here today to give you a new mission as an angel.{wait}{clear}
I have heard much from Gabriel about your past work.{wait}{clear}
I want you to descend once more to a new world below and, through the turmoil surrounding it, discover who the fallen angel is.{wait}{clear}
Of course, preventing turmoil and ruin in that world is also an important goal.{wait}{clear}
In that regard you seem trustworthy, so I am not worried.{wait}{clear}
However, I sense a most evil omen in the turmoil of this world.{wait}{clear}
We have not yet grasped the reason for it.{wait}{clear}
Many other worlds below are beset by turmoil of all kinds.{n}{wait}{clear}
It is impossible for us archangels to examine every one of them in detail.{wait}{clear}
And so I want you, with your excellence, to act in our stead.{wait}{clear}
When you have traced the fallen angel through the turmoil on the surface, report it to me.{wait}{clear}
There is one more thing you must be careful of.{wait}{clear}
The world you will descend to this time, "Arcaya," is not as strongly bound to the Heavens as "Infos," where you descended before.{wait}{clear}
So your powers as an angel will be more limited. Keep that in mind as you act.{wait}{clear}
Once again, we have asked the fairy realm for help.{wait}{clear}
